blocks.text: Romeo: offline inspection syncs on reconnect (10 min)
Juliet: the signed PDF for that same inspection (10 min)
Export by site: say next sprint, plainly. Don't show anything that isn't built.
A recorded video of the sync as backup
A spare tablet, charged, already in airplane mode
Test the room's wifi Friday morning
PDF open in a second tab before we start
If the live sync fails: play the video, go straight to the PDF, keep talking about their yards.
